title: Etale near a point from smoothness and zero fibre dimension there
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$, $\kappa(s)$ its residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ the fibre [def-pc-base-change]. Assume that there is an open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$ such that $f|_U:U\to S$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and that the dimension of $X_s$ at the point corresponding to $x$ is $0$ [def-kun-dimension]. Then there is an open subscheme $U'\subseteq U$ with $x\in U'$ such that $f|_{U'}:U'\to S$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 0A43 (label lemma-check-smoothness-on-infinitesimal-nbhds), proof, last sentence ('Part (2) follows from (1) and the fact that a morphism is etale if and only if it is smooth of relative dimension 0'); with morphisms.tex: remark after Definition 02GI (line 8079), Lemma 02G1 (lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free: Omega_{X/S} finite locally free of rank dim_x(X_{f(x)}) for f smooth) and Definition 02G2 (definition-smooth-relative-dimension)

proof.text: Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.exists_smoothOfRelativeDimension_resLE (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth) to g = U.ι ≫ f and xU = ⟨x,hx⟩. It gives affine opens A in S and B in U and a natural number d, with g.resLE A B smooth of relative dimension d. Compose with the open immersion A.ι, then transport through the isomorphism B ≅ U.ι image B. Thus V = U.ι image B is an open of X contained in U, contains x, and V.ι ≫ f is smooth of relative dimension d. These compositions add relative dimension zero, by Mathlib smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp.

Let W = (f.fiberι (f x)) preimage V, an open of the original fibre containing f.asFiber x. The restriction pullback square is obtained by pasting isPullback_morphismRestrict with the defining fibre square. Base change stability of SmoothOfRelativeDimension gives relative dimension d for W.ι ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField (f x). Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth) to the point ⟨f.asFiber x,hxW⟩ in W. Its dimension is d. Open-subspace invariance identifies this dimension with that of f.asFiber x in the original fibre, which is zero by hypothesis. Injectivity of the natural-number cast gives d = 0.
Mathlib Etale.iff_smoothOfRelativeDimension_zero converts the relative-dimension-zero instance for V.ι ≫ f into Etale. Return V, its inclusion V ≤ U, its membership x ∈ V and this Etale proof.
